shops.name: Shops and makers
shops.title: Your own shop, on your own domain
shops.lead: Stop paying marketplace fees on every sale. Sell from a shop with your name on it, keep every customer and email them again whenever you like.
points: Paid straight to you
Checkout uses your own payment account, so the money goes to you, not through a marketplace.
Your buyers, your list
Every buyer lands in your own email list, with follow-up emails already written.
Change it yourself
Products, shipping and discounts you can update any time, no developer needed.
questions: I already sell on a marketplace. Do I have to leave?
No. Keep it if it works for you. Your own shop sits beside it, and every customer who finds you there is yours to keep.
Can I use my own payment account?
Yes. You connect the payment account you already use, and payments go straight to it.

specialty.name: Specialty retailers
specialty.title: A shop that stays open
specialty.lead: If big platforms have closed your shop or frozen your payments before, sell from your own site on your own domain, with the payment account you choose.
points: Bring your own processor
Checkout works with the payment account you already have, including processors that accept your industry.
Age check and terms
Add an age check and your own terms pages, so the shop fits the rules you sell under.
Your customers stay yours
Your customer list and order history stay with you, with follow-up emails ready to go.
questions: Will my shop be closed without warning?
Your shop runs on your own site and domain, so it doesn't depend on a marketplace's product rules.
Which payment processors work?
You connect your own account. Ask us about yours before you start and we'll tell you how it connects.

courses.name: Course creators
courses.title: Your courses, community and list in one place
courses.lead: Stop paying for several tools and giving a platform its cut. Teach on a site with your name on it, for one monthly price.
points: Courses that track progress
Lessons, quizzes and progress for every student.
Your own community
A members' area on your own site instead of a separate app.
Email from the same place
Write to students and new leads without another tool.
questions: Can I move my courses over?
Yes. We can help you move your first course in so you can see how it works.
Do you take a cut of my sales?
No. You pay one monthly price and keep what you sell.

associations.name: Chambers and associations
associations.title: Members, events and dues on one site
associations.lead: Bring your member directory, event sign-ups and dues together on one site your staff can run, without a developer.
points: Member directory
Profiles each member can keep up to date themselves.
Events with sign-up
Members sign up and pay for events online.
Dues paid online
Renewals paid by card, with reminder emails sent for you.
questions: Can we keep our current domain?
Yes. Your site moves to your own domain whenever you are ready.
Can our members get websites too?
Yes. You can offer every member business its own website as a member benefit.

churches.name: Churches
churches.title: A church website that runs itself
churches.lead: Events, online giving, small groups and your weekly email on one simple site, and nobody at church has to run the tech.
points: Online giving
One-time and recurring gifts, paid into your church's own account.
Events and groups
People sign up for events and small groups online.
Sermons and a weekly email
Post sermons and send your weekly email from the same place.
questions: Who keeps it up to date?
Anyone on your team can change the words and photos. We look after hosting, updates and backups.
Where does giving go?
Straight to your church's own payment account.

locations.name: Franchises and multi-location businesses
locations.title: One look for every location
locations.lead: Give every location the same site, each with its own bookings, hours and domain, all managed from one place.
points: New locations in minutes
Each new location starts from your brand's own design.
Bookings per location
Every location takes bookings with its own staff and hours.
One bill
One monthly bill for every location's website.
questions: Can each location change its own site?
Yes, within your brand. Locations update their hours, staff and offers; the look stays yours.
Can every location have its own domain?
Yes. Each site can use its own domain or a page of yours.

freelancers.name: Freelancers and studios
freelancers.title: Websites for your clients, under your name
freelancers.lead: Say yes when clients ask for a website. We host, update and back them up; you keep the client and add a monthly line to every invoice.
points: Live in minutes
Each client site starts from a ready-made design you make their own.
Looked after for you
Updates, security, backups and support are handled.
Your price on top
Charge your own price, so every site adds monthly income.
questions: Will my clients see your name?
No. Your clients deal with you, and the sites carry your brand.
Do I have to look after the sites?
No. Hosting, updates and backups are handled. You stay the person your client talks to.

software.name: Software companies
software.title: A website for every customer, from inside your product
software.lead: When a customer signs up, their website is made automatically under your brand, and removed when they leave.
points: Made on sign-up
Connect our API, Zapier, Make, n8n or HighLevel, and each new customer gets a site.
Tidy when they leave
Sites are suspended or removed automatically when a customer cancels.
One bill
One monthly bill for every customer's website.
questions: How do we connect it?
Through our API, or with Zapier, Make, n8n or HighLevel if you'd rather not write code.
Whose name do customers see?
Yours. The websites carry your brand.
